Weddings A wedding is more than a day it's a story of connection, emotion, and fleeting moments.

                        With a documentary approach and a cinematic eye, I capture the authentic emotions of your day.

                        The result is a visual memory that reflects who you are, not just how the day looked.

Weddings The Art Of Presence Every couple has a unique story, and my approach is to observe without interference.

                        I capture candid moments, the glances, the laughter, the details that make your wedding yours.

                        From the quiet anticipation of getting ready to the energy of the celebration, I document your day as it naturally unfolds, creating a visual narrative rooted in authenticity and trust. ► INQUIRE AVAILABILITY

\ ABOUT The Art Of Noticing I’m Thomas Mamfredas—filmmaker and photographer based in Zakynthos, crafting wedding and commercial films with a calm, detail-driven approach. The work is quiet when it needs to be, honest when it matters, and always focused on story. From intimate vows to brand narratives, I look for the small truths: light on skin, a hand squeeze, the breath before a line. Fewer, better choices. Images that feel like memories, not performances.

\ APPROACH Process Discovery (goals, audience, references) → Plan (scope & schedule) → Production (filming/design/dev) → Delivery (launch, QA, support). Fewer, better choices. Guidance when needed, space when not.

\ Stories ZAKYNTHOS, GREECE While wandering through Zakynthos, I often find myself drawn to the details that quietly go unnoticed the play of light, the textures, the fleeting moments hidden in everyday scenes. Through the lens of Art of Noticing, these photographs became small reminders of the beauty that surrounds us when we slow down and truly look. Here are some of my favorite images from the island, captured along the way. I hope they invite you to see Zakynthos through my eyes and perhaps notice something new yourself.
